findings.title: Capped diagnostics bypass rewire collision rejection
findings.why_it_matters: The default reject-new geometry policy can persist a newly unsafe route when diagnostic collection reaches its configured cap. A destructive endpoint rewire is then accepted even though the tool promises to reject newly introduced collision errors, leaving a BPMN file whose retained DI route crosses shapes or edges.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat DIAGNOSTICS_TRUNCATED as a fatal resource/invariant result in assertSafeConnectionGeometry, matching assertSafeGeometryPatch, and add a capped-diagnostics rewire regression test.
evidence: Trigger: configure maxListingItems to 1, start with the selected connection already producing one collision diagnostic, then rewire an endpoint with collisionPolicy reject-new so its snapped retained route collides with a second shape.

Both before and after validation calls cap diagnostics at maxListingItems (src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:1250-1259). BoundedGeometryDiagnostics keeps at most that many selected diagnostics, omits later selected collisions once the cap is full, and appends DIAGNOSTICS_TRUNCATED (src/core/BpmnGeometry.ts:167-193).

The after report can therefore retain only the pre-existing collision plus DIAGNOSTICS_TRUNCATED; introducedDiagnostics finds no new retained error, and assertSafeConnectionGeometry only rejects RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, not DIAGNOSTICS_TRUNCATED (src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:2303-2331). The mutation then reaches commitMutation persistence.

The batch geometry-patch guard already fails closed for either RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED or DIAGNOSTICS_TRUNCATED (src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:2356-2360), demonstrating that truncation is intended to make diagnostics unsafe to rely on.

residual_risks: The same capped-diagnostics fail-open path is shared by update_connection_geometry; this review intentionally scopes the finding to update_connection rewires.
testing_gaps: No update_connection test sets a tiny maxListingItems cap, preserves one selected pre-existing geometry diagnostic, then introduces another during endpoint snapping to prove reject-new fails closed.
